environment: production bundle + real Worker core.js + real Render kyc/admin routers + PostgreSQL

scenarios.name: 1. admin: «Запросить дополнительные материалы» → «Новое фото документа», reason «Фото размыто», preview of the user text, double click → 1 request, status stays PENDING, audit
2. user (390): request with its reason in Verification, stage in the badge and Profile («Открыть запрос»), persists across reload; no selfie asked

3. user: too-small photo refused with its size, offline attempt fails without sending, then double click → 1 email «[KYC] Новое фото документа», EXIF stripped, request RECEIVED, 1 audit, 1 admin notification
4. admin: queue filter «Получены доп. материалы» lists the user; stage, Message-ID in the history; «Начать повторную проверку» → «Повторная проверка»
5. admin: selfie request with an optional comment; preview shows the generated text + comment
6. user (390): selfie via the camera (Chromium synthetic camera); PDF refused; send blocked until consent; 1 email «[KYC] Селфи…» with the consent line; consent stored
7. comparison (1440 side by side, 390 stacked): local files only (< 4 KB to the server), zoom 156 % + rotate 90°, fullscreen, no face recognition text or score; four buttons present
8. decision from the comparison: «Подтвердить» → confirmation dialog → APPROVED; the request closes as APPROVED, received data kept

9. document + selfie: «Требуются документ и селфи» → after the PDF «Требуется селфи» → selfie from a file (record call failed once → sealed receipt retried, still 1 email) → «Дополнительные материалы получены»

10. access: another user's request = 404 (same as missing), no session 401, non-admin 403 on request/acknowledge/queue, part not requested 409, already received 409, no consent 400, fake image 415, closed after decision 409 — 0 emails

11. repeats: same click key → same request (201 then 200); a new request supersedes the old one (history keeps it and its files); «Отклонить» from the comparison → REJECTED, request closed, the user sees the reason
12. layout: user request panel and admin request form/comparison at 320/360/390/430/1440 px — no horizontal overflow, touch targets ≥ 40 px
files never reach Render (0 multipart, largest body < 4 KB, 0 document reads); edge logs carry identifiers only
